system.description: A fae warrior adorned in armor made of leaves and bark.
system.notes:
Normal | Standard

A fae warrior adorned in armor made of leaves and bark.
Motives & Tactics: Ambush, hide, overwhelm, protect, trail

Difficulty: 13 | Thresholds: 6/11 | HP: 4 | Stress: 2

ATK: +0 | Weapon: Melee | 1d8+1 physical

Experience: Tracker +2

Features

Pack Tactics - Passive: If the Soldier makes a standard attack and another Sidhe Soldier is within Melee range of the target, deal 1d8+5 physical damage instead of their standard damage.

Fae Control - Action: Spend a Fear to disorient a target within Close range. The target must succeed on a Finesse Reaction Roll (15) or take 1d10 physical damage as they trip and fall.

Blend In - Reaction: When the Soldier makes a successful attack, you can mark a Stress to become Cloaked until the Soldier's next attack or a PC succeeds on an Instinct Roll (14) to find them.
